static_traits.name: Jiang Ming
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends who support him, but finds it hard to open up to them; fears being judged, and relationship-building is affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone; expresses clearly, with fairly good logic; able to describe their own feelings and experiences; cooperates fairly well

basic_info.main_problem: Often feeling treated as a 'weirdo' because of a distinctive appearance (blue-orange hair), feeling misunderstood and judged; as negative comments and stares increase, this feeling worsens, leading to Social anxiety and Decreased self-confidence.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want to find ways to cope with these and get my confidence back.'
growth_experiences: Started skateboarding in High school, often facing others' judgment and labels (like being seen as 'idle' or a 'weirdo'), forming experiences of being misunderstood and labeled, deepening sensitivity to others' evaluations and unease.

A few years ago, after starting to dye their hair blue and orange, they frequently encountered strangers' gazes and negative comments in public places; this experience continuously strengthens the feeling of 'being judged / misunderstood', stronger recently.

core_beliefs: Being different from others makes me seen as a weirdo, not accepted
I am easily labeled and misunderstood by others

special_situations.event: Being stared at by strangers in public or receiving negative comments about one's appearance (hair color)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others stare at me or comment on my appearance, it means they think I am a weirdo
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces going out or changes clothing/hairstyle to fit in and reduce the possibility of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They look down on me; I am just a weirdo

special_situations.event: Meeting newly acquainted people for the first time or attending unfamiliar social occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I interact with new people, they will label me an 'idler/weirdo' and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding meeting new people, Reduced socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will surely judge me and not accept me

special_situations.event: Recalls and receives feedback about appearance (both praise and disparagement)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as negative comments appear, it means the Overall evaluation is all negative
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or negating compliments, focusing only on negative feedback to 'prepare' for judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Most people do not like my kind of appearance

special_situations.event: Being triggered into memories of being labeled for skateboarding in High school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being labeled in the past means it will always be so now
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labeling myself a 'weirdo' preemptively, or temporarily escaping others' judgment and Anxiety by throwing myself into skateboarding
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have always been seen as a weirdo; this will never change

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and accepted, appreciated as one's unique self
defense_goal: Reducing the likelihood of being judged through Avoids socializing and changing appearance
Preemptively strikes with self-devaluation and self-labeling to reduce the risk of being hurt
Only expresses oneself in 'safe situations' such as skateboarding to maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A misunderstood outsider, a 'weirdo' prone to being judged

manifestations: Expresses a unique self through dyed hair and skateboarding
In public, others' evaluations shake free expression, creating inner conflict
Afraid of being judged; hard to build meaningful connections with others
Has supportive friends but finds it hard to open up about feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats others' evaluations of 'weirdo / idler' as fact
Trying to change one's style to fit the so-called 'normal' in order to gain acceptance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessively self-scrutinizing in public, repeatedly doubting 'whether something is wrong with me'
In socializing, is careful and tense; hard to express oneself naturally

exception_events.target_problem: In public or when Interacting with newly met people, the client usually feels judged and develops Social anxiety, thus avoiding contact.
exception_events.unique_outcome: While skateboarding, the client feels Freedom and control, can focus on the present, cares less about others' views, experiencing confidence and positive emotions.
exception_events.reason: Different situation and approach: skateboarding provides high focus and a sense of control, attention Turning against the self skill and experience; using self-worth and inner feelings as reference rather than external evaluation, so Anxiety is markedly reduced.

positive_force: The sense of control and self-efficacy brought by skateboarding can evoke confidence and positive emotions
Able to notice and willing to try focusing on positive feedback (someone praised the hair color)
Proactively seeks help and is willing to try new methods (reality testing, challenging assumptions)
negative_force: Excessively focuses on others' evaluations and external recognition
Cognitive distortions (mind reading, overgeneralization, mental filtering) worsening Self-doubt
Social avoidance behaviors maintaining the Anxiety cycle
Long-term experience of being labeled leads to sensitivity and fear of being judged

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and Anxiety in public and when interacting with new friends
antecedent: Being stared at or having one's appearance commented on by strangers
target_behavior.core_reason: Past experiences of being labeled and cognitive biases like mind reading/overgeneralization about others' evaluations, internalized as the negative core belief 'being different means being seen as a weirdo'
target_behavior.function: Escaping judgment and shame, reducing immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building meaningful relationships; Impaired self-esteem; social life and self-care affected

target_behavior.behavior: Changes appearance to cater to others (suppressing self-expression)
antecedent: Anticipating being judged or hearing negative comments
Preparing to attend social or public occasions
target_behavior.core_reason: Tries to gain external recognition through pleasing, reducing the risk of being labeled
target_behavior.function: Gains others' acceptance / reduces negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in self-consistency; short-term Anxiety may ease but long-term Self-worth damaged
